prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic low-angle seated fashion portrait of an approved adult woman relaxing on a sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with natural auburn loose waves and a soft relaxed smile, reclining sideways with one leg extended toward camera and the other bent. She wears a pastel-pink fitted top, tiered pink-and-mint skirt, pastel-pink stockings with decorative bows, and small pastel hair clips.
prompt.composition_elements: Strong 24mm forced perspective with foreground foot enlarged naturally, face kept sharp, cushions and sofa visible, balanced pastel interior.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural indoor daylight, realistic skin and fabric texture, playful confident lifestyle mood, respectful fashion framing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical portrait, 24mm equivalent, camera low near floor, f/4-f/5.6 depth, accurate anatomy, realistic perspective and texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical low-angle seated fashion portrait of an approved adult auburn-haired woman reclining sideways on a sofa. She wears a pastel-pink fitted top, tiered pink-and-mint skirt, pastel-pink stockings with small bows, and pastel hair clips. One leg extends naturally toward the low camera while the other bends, her face remains sharp with a soft relaxed smile. Use 24mm forced perspective, natural indoor light, realistic cushions, fabric, skin, and respectful playful pastel fashion mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, fetish framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra limbs, deformed feet, distorted perspective
